mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of quarters following YoY GDP acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, if not accompanied by a contemporaneous rise in unemployment, signals a supply-driven inflationary shock that will drive the Fed to tighten policy and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines > 0.5% in 1 month and UNRATE does not rise
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in nonfarm payrolls, if accompanied by a decline in the unemployment rate, signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 300k in 1 month and UNRATE declines
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales, if accompanied by a rise in the unemployment rate, signals a demand-driven recessionary shock that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings estimates are revised downward.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS declines > 1% in 1 month and UNRATE rises
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating rate of housing starts, if not accompanied by a rise in the federal funds rate, signals a supply-driven expansionary shock that will produce positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as construction activity boosts economic growth.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 5% YoY and FEDFUNDS does not rise
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the unemployment rate, if not accompanied by a contemporaneous decline in industrial production, signals a labor market shock that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending slows and corporate earnings estimates are revised downward.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month and INDPRO does not decline
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances where the trigger condition is met.
